LanguageData.RaidersInherit.InheritEntireRaid.Label: Inherit entire remaining raid
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.InheritEntireRaid.Tooltip: If enabled, every living raider still on the map joins your colony, instead of only the number set below. No raiders are released as allies in this mode.
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.RaidersToInherit.Label: Raiders to inherit
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.RaidersToInherit.Tooltip: This many randomly chosen surviving raiders join your colony. The rest are released as non-hostile allies and leave the map peacefully. If the raid has fewer survivors than this, all of them join.
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.JoinedLetterText: With your colony defeated, {0} of the attacking raiders from {1} have decided to join you instead: {2}.\n\nThe remaining {3} raiders have been released as non-hostile wanderers and are leaving the area. They will not attack your new colonists, but they have not joined your colony either.
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.JoinedLetterTextAllJoined: With your colony defeated, the entire attacking raid from {1} has decided to join you instead: {2}.\n\nNone of the attackers remain hostile.
